items.title: Flatness of a module over a square-zero thickening is equivalent to flatness of its reduction plus injectivity of the conormal multiplication
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-modules.tex (Modules on Sites)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma characterizes flatness of a module over a square-zero thickening O' -> O in terms of the flatness of its reduction F = F'/I F' over O together with injectivity of the multiplication map I tensor_O F -> F'. The forward direction uses stability of flatness under the change of rings O' -> O and applies the tensor product by F' to the defining exact sequence, invoking the vanishing of Tor for flat modules (proof lines 5018-5027). The converse is the substantive direction: it takes an injective map of O'-modules, cuts it along the subsheaves annihilated by I, and works with the resulting commutative diagram, using throughout that tensoring an O'-module annihilated by I agrees with tensoring over O (proof lines 5028-5055). H2: the diagram chase along the I-torsion filtration of the injection is the substance and is written out.
